capabilities: Create categorized button panels in list, tabbed, or folder views
Open files, run commands, open links, create templated files, and run JavaScript scripts from buttons
Configure multi-step action sequences executed in order with one click
Reorder buttons and categories with drag-and-drop in a dedicated sort mode
Customize button icons using built-in Lucide icons or pasted SVG code
extras: Provides a downloadable showcase vault with configuration examples and supports installation via BRAT for beta users; warns against running scripts from untrusted sources.
problem: Opening files or running commands in Obsidian requires the command palette or file browser, which means typing or navigating instead of clicking a persistent visual launcher.
summary: Customizable button panel that gives one-click access to files, Obsidian commands, web links, and vault JavaScript scripts.
